reviews.text:
Cookie is so happy! 🥰 My dog ​​had a lot of difficulty interacting with other animals, but with all the patience, affection, and dedication from the staff, he's improving a lot. ❤️

Today I feel incredibly safe leaving him there at work because I know he's being very well cared for, welcomed, and looked after. I have a lot of confidence in your work and I'm very grateful for all the love you show him. 🐶💙

I was very pleased with the experience of leaving my dog ​​Nina at a dog hotel for the first time. It had been a while since I'd traveled because I didn't like having to ask a family member to look after her. My biggest concern was how she would behave with other dogs, since in the building where I live she tends to bark a lot and pull hard on the leash when she sees other dogs. Juliana was very attentive during the assessment, and Nina was very happy during her four-day stay! Seeing the photos of her interacting with her "doggy friends" was really cool, haha. Thank you from the bottom of my heart ❤️
Lots of love and attention for our pets. I highly recommend it!
PityDog is wonderful! It's my son's haven. A fun and, above all, welcoming place for him and for me. I have complete trust in the staff, they are so sweet!
Simply my dog's second home. First-class service. They love what they do and do it with excellence. I recommend them without hesitation.

I highly recommend them to anyone who truly cares about their pets! Just think of the love, respect, affection, punctuality, and professionalism these girls have!

You are wonderful! Thank you for everything, always!

Hugs,

Carol, Thor, and Bethânia!!! 😍

Amazing daycare! My Pinschers love it so much! They go crazy when Aunt Ju comes to pick them up! Besides helping with socialization, there are also many fun activities, affection, and care.
As a pet mom, I feel super secure because I receive videos and photos of them having fun throughout the day. I trust them completely!

I loved the space and the service! A pleasant environment with stimuli for dogs to interact safely. The team was very efficient in helping my dog ​​adapt and provided moments of leisure, rest, and socialization while we were traveling. We received daily photos and videos throughout the stay.
I loved it! It's a great place for our furry friends to socialize. The owners are super caring. I leave my furry son there with my eyes closed.
My little girl has been with them for 9 years now. Pure joy! 💙🐶 …
Excellent boarding. We only trust PityDog; he arrives happy and leaves happy. Thank you, Aunt Juh and Vivi, you are wonderful!

I recommend them to everyone who loves their furry children and wants more family-like care. They are super careful with the pets and love what they do. They follow procedures to ensure safety and responsibility when pets arrive and leave, the facilities are adapted to comfortably accommodate pets, are well-ventilated, and they provide activities to prevent them from having a monotonous routine.
Aunt Vivi and Aunt Juh are wonderful with our Bella. They always keep us updated with cute videos and photos. We've known PityDog for a few years now, and our Bella couldn't be in better hands.
❤️Thank you so much❤️

There's no better daycare! I'm in love with PityDog. Juh and Vivi have my heart and my family's. The way they treat our four-legged children is exceptional. They are very affectionate, special, and the place is clean, safe, and spacious... My dog ​​loves them both and being at daycare. I always recommend them without hesitation.
PityDog is a place we can completely trust; we've been customers for 2 years. The girls are very affectionate, careful, and responsible.

Our trip was very smooth, as Pitydog always reassured us, since our dog Luke was treated extremely well, with lots of love, and the daycare sent us videos of him every day. We will definitely always board him there, and we will always recommend them to our relatives and friends.

The only place I've left my little Maltese in years. He gets super happy just hearing about going to daycare. Aunts Ju and Vivi take great care of the dogs with activities they love. I highly recommend it ♥️♥️♥️

I love Pitydog and my lovely, sweet Lulu does too!
There, safety is guaranteed, and besides being a super cool place, they always keep me informed with photos and videos about my dog. It's a place I trust a lot, and I know my Lulu loves being there. She plays a lot and receives a lot of affection, which is very important to me. My four-legged daughter is super well cared for; and I always feel warm inside seeing how well my Lulu is treated there. I trust and recommend them!
I trust them completely!! It's the best pet boarding I've ever known and where I've taken my pets. I recommend it to everyone I know who loves their four-legged children ❤️

The girls - Ju and Vivi - are super welcoming and attentive to our animals... a suitable and cozy place for the dogs, full of activities. Plus, we never lose touch with them! And that makes all the difference...
Excellent! I always leave my dog ​​there. On weekends or long trips. Totally reliable. I receive videos every day and I can rest easy. Plus, my dog ​​loves it!
Excellent. Every time we need to travel, it's our first and only option. The animals are treated with so much love, respect, and care.

It's the only place I trust to leave my dog ​​while I'm traveling. I've been using their boarding service since 2021 and I highly recommend it. There, I'm certain that Paçoca will be well cared for and loved. During his stay, I receive several videos and photos, as well as updates on his behavior. Both Aunt Vivi and Aunt Ju are super attentive and manage to reassure the anxious and homesick owner.

Our experience with Pitydog couldn't have been better. We were traveling abroad for 10 days and had never been away from our furry son. We were nervous because we wouldn't be able to return earlier if he wasn't feeling well. With Aunt Ju's guidance, we adapted him, spending a few days before the trip with him only at daycare (daycare) and then a nighttime session as well (overnight daycare, only picking him up at the end of the second day). Aunt Ju's love for our Luke and other dogs was so captivating that we felt confident he would be okay. During the trip, we received daily videos of him at the daycare, interacting with the other dogs and participating, albeit shyly, in the activities organized by Aunt Ju. It was very special! I can only thank them for taking such good care of our little darling. I highly recommend Pitydog.
Wonderful daycare!! Pleasant space and amazing caregivers!! I recommend it without a doubt! My furry friend loves daycare days.
An excellent and extremely reliable place to leave our pets. I'm always very satisfied and recommend it without hesitation!
PityDog...they are wonderful, full of care for animals and their owners.

The girls are very caring and responsible, always keeping us informed about what's happening during our stay. I trust their work 1000%... impeccable!!! I recommend them to all my friends because it's not easy to find people who love what they do! Congratulations on your dedication, you are top-notch, Aunties Ju and Vivi!!!
Wonderful experience! Super welcoming environment! The staff are amazing in caring for and loving our furry children! I highly recommend it!
The place is wonderful, the owners are super caring. And it's a great place to leave your four-legged child.

The best dog boarding and daycare in the world! I only trust them to take care of my furry friends 😍 (they've been there since they were puppies)
They are very careful and loving, and they always keep us informed about their routine!
Long live PityDog ❤️
A wonderful and very trustworthy place. I've been leaving my four-legged children at PityDog for over 6 years and I don't regret it at all. Care and fun guaranteed.

I am extremely satisfied with PityDog. The staff is very attentive and caring. I love that I can leave my daughter without worries, knowing she is happy and very well cared for. I love watching the videos of them interacting and participating in activities.

They offer bathing, grooming, and rides!

I recommend this daycare to everyone looking for a reliable and fun place! Lexi is very happy when her aunt comes to pick her up!

Thank you so much 😊
A welcoming, clean, and safe environment, with dedicated professionals, and my little girl loves it… ❤️

The best boarding your dog could have! And I say this seeing Lord's excitement every time he sees Aunt Juh and Aunt Vivi... he already knows he's going to have fun and go to a safe place. Lots of affection, lots of care, and several sensational interactive activities. We have videos and photos more than once a day to track the stay, and they are always available to answer our messages.
I love and trust them completely! Thank you, ladies, for always making my little pony so happy!
I love the Pity Dog and Cristal too.

For a while now, I've been leaving my son with the ladies at Pitydog when I need to travel or be away for a few days, and I get to see the care and affection they give our pets. My heart aches when I'm away, there's no way around it, haha, but the ladies provide complete reassurance, always monitoring and sending updates. Lorenzo loves the pet hotel, the ladies, and his friends <3

Wonderful! I've been leaving my dogs there for years. My elderly dog, who has since passed away, used to stay there, and my two current dogs stay weekly. They are cared for with great affection and attention. There are environmental enrichment activities. They are professionals, they understand canine behavior and socialization, they administer medication, food, everything that is necessary for your dog's specific needs. You can trust them completely.
